w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Gavel, Big-Eyes, The Ugly Beast, The Big Beast) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chorus Line is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Terms of Service is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brunhilde just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Ad Break. It's here.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ SYSTEM: "The long game, little hoarders. A GRANARY. Stockpile 20,000 kcal, 500 wood and 2,000 kcal of PRESERVED food — food that WAITS. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The audience finds delayed gratification EXOTIC. So do stomachs, we are told."
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

★ IDENTIFIED: Death Cap. An olive-green capped mushroom with white gills, a ring on the stem, and a cup at the base. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (24/14/8), with 5 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 45 → 24 · capped · Craft 9 · Talk 17 · Explore 59 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Raniera Tapsell ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,166 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
